rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING A TAX ON THE SALE OF SHARES OF STOCK LISTED AND TRADED THROUGH THE LOCAL STOCK EXCHANGE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED, BY INSERTING A NEW SECTION AND REPEALING CERTAIN SUBSECTIONS THEREOF (Stock Transaction Tax)
rows.abstract: Declares that ---     "SEC. 124-A. LEVIED, ASSESSED AND COLLECTED ON EVERY SALE, BARTER, EXCHANGE,   OR OTHER DISPOSITION OF SHARES OF STOCK  LISTED AND  TRADED THROUGH  THE LOCAL  STOCK EXCHANGE  A TAX EQUIVALENT TO ONE  HALF OF ONE PERCENT (1/2 OF1%) OF THE GROSS SELLING  PRICE OR GROSS VALUE IN  MONEY OF THE SHARES OF STOCK SOLD, BARTERED, EXCHANGED  OR OTHERWISE DISPOSED WHICH SHALL BE  PAID  BY THE   SELLER OR TRANSFEROR: PROVIDED, HOWEVER,  THAT ANY GAIN DERIVED FROM THE SALE, BARTER, EXCHANGE  OR OTHER DISPOSITION OF SUCH SHARES OF STOCK SHALL BE  EXEMPT FROM THE  TAX IMPOSED  IN SECTION 21(d), 24(e)(2), 25(a)(6)(C), AND 25(b)(5)(C) OF THIS CODE: PROVIDED, FURTHER,  THAT SUCH GAIN SHALL LIKEWISE BE EXEMPT FROM THE  REGULAR INDIVIDUUAL  OR CORPORATE INCOME   TAX IMPOSED  BY THIS   CODE: PROVIDED, FINALLY, THAT THE SELLER  OR TRANSFEROR SHALL FILE THE TAX  RETURN AND  PAY THE TAX THEREON WITHIN  THIRTY (30) DAYS FROM DATE OF SALE OF TRANSFER OF SUCH SHARES OF STOCK." * * *
rows.status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA07717) enacted on 1994-05-05
